install.macos_download: Resolve the current official DMG from Muse's production Sparkle feed https://www.facebook.com/endo/release/appcast.xml?channel=production, using the first item's enclosure URL. Download it immediately: the official fbcdn.net URL is signed and expires. The inspected Muse 7.0 package supports Intel x86_64 and Apple Silicon arm64 and requires macOS 14.0 or later. Recheck the current package's requirements before installing.
install.note: Meta Muse is a cloud agent. EchoBird supports macOS installation, detection and native launch only; account switching, quota access and third-party API model configuration are excluded. No native Windows or Linux desktop download is currently offered; use https://muse.ai/ on those platforms.

install_flow.summary: Check the existing Muse installation and macOS compatibility, install the current official signed app, refresh detection, and launch.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture first. On Windows or Linux, explain that no official native desktop package is offered and provide https://muse.ai/; do not run macOS commands or fabricate an installer. On macOS, check /Applications/Muse.app and ~/Applications/Muse.app plus EchoBird's detection. Reuse an existing client instead of overwriting it. For a new install, macOS older than 14 is unsupported by the currently inspected package.

Create a temporary directory. Fetch https://www.facebook.com/endo/release/appcast.xml?channel=production with curl -fL, saving the XML to a file; parse the fresh DMG URL with /usr/bin/xmllint --xpath 'string(/rss/channel/item[1]/enclosure/@url)' <feed-file>. Download that HTTPS enclosure URL with curl -fL into the temporary directory. If the feed is unavailable or no longer contains a DMG, obtain the current Mac download from https://ai.meta.com/muse/download/ instead. Do not hardcode an expiring CDN URL, guess a download filename, or use a third-party mirror.

Mount the downloaded DMG read-only with hdiutil attach -readonly -nobrowse, locate Muse.app, and inspect Contents/Info.plist. Require bundle ID com.meta.endo, verify the app with codesign --verify --deep --strict, and check codesign -dv --verbose=4 reports TeamIdentifier=V9WTTPBFK9. Check the current LSMinimumSystemVersion against sw_vers -productVersion and inspect Contents/MacOS/Muse with lipo -archs for the host architecture. Stop on incompatibility or signature failure. Preserve normal macOS Gatekeeper checks; do not clear quarantine or bypass security policy.

Install the verified Muse.app with ditto into /Applications when writable, otherwise ~/Applications. Do not replace an existing installation or read, modify, or remove user account/configuration files. Verify the copied app's signature and Gatekeeper assessment with spctl --assess --type execute before reporting success. Detach the mounted image and clean up only this attempt's temporary files, including on failure.

Refresh EchoBird tool detection. Report installation success only when Muse is detected at its native Contents/MacOS/Muse executable. Launch the detected application through EchoBird's normal tool launch action; the user signs in inside the official Muse client. Installation and passive navigation must not start account capture, fetch quota, or write model/account settings.
